# Recorded journey

One small journey on seed `mars`, stored under its journey keys exactly as `/journey/{key}` serves it once inflated: stop 0 at the origin with a 60 m disk (its four chunks, their disk pack, revealed mask and manifest) and one 30 m drive from the origin to (25, 15) published as 30 s slices with its segment manifest. `scripts/journey-fixture.ts` builds it deterministically and the client tests rebuild it to compare against these files; regenerate after any change to terrain, driving or the binary formats with `JITI_ALIAS="{\"#shared\":\"$PWD/shared\",\"#server\":\"$PWD/server\"}" pnpm exec jiti scripts/record-journey-fixture.ts` from the repository root.
